chapter: Moving, Columbia Missouri and leaving home
title: Leaving high school before graduation
summary: Dance asks if he missed graduation; Thompson says yes, he left to escape possible violence after the shock of the lynching.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: Yes, I'm sure it does. Well, I want to ask you, does that mean that you left to join the CC -- what was it called.
It was called the CC Camp.
CC Camp. Well, does that mean that you were robbed of your graduation of your high school?
That's exactly right. I had to leave school because of my choice, to get away from that environment, I really -- it was mainly that I thought that something might happen in the way of violence.
Yes. You were so appalled, really.
Yes, it just completely took me by shock.
